memoryMeaning: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in each fresh native process after the stock timer stops. Zero values are unavailable, not zero memory. Static stack allocation is the largest subq from rsp, excluding pushes and callers.
startupMeaning: Fresh process wall time with one stock-driver iteration; includes launch and teardown.
scope: Four same-host paired cells. Sieve and heap from the main run; UTF-8 from its isolated repeat; tokenization from a separate affected-code control.
